3 Effect

Use an action or an Asset to heal and discard.

cards.body:
3x Distress ➜ Panic.
4x Distress ➜ Hopeless.

3x Distress ➜ Panic.
4x Distress ➜ Hopeless.
Use an action or an Asset to recover and discard.

cards.body: 4x Injury: You are Taken Out. You cannot act until the fiction and recovery rules allow it.

Heal your Injuries to discard.

cards.footer: Recover from your Distress to discard.
cards.description:
3x Distress: You can only play the top card of your Outcome deck.
Recover from your Distress to discard.

cards.title: Hopeless

cards.footer: Recover from your Distress to discard.
cards.description:
4x Distress: You can only flee or give up.
Recover from your Distress to discard.

cards.title: Stuck
cards.body: You cannot move, but you can still take other actions.
cards.footer: Use an action to free yourself and discard.
cards.description:
You cannot move, but you can still take other actions.
Use an action to free yourself and discard.

cards.title: Hindered
cards.body: You can only move or take actions, but not both.

cards.description:
You can only move or take actions, but not both.
Use an action to free yourself and discard.

cards.title: Boost
cards.body: Your next action or defense has +1 Effect or +1 Move.
cards.description: Your next action or defense has +1 Effect or +1 Move.

cards.title: Complication
cards.body: A Complication makes your life harder.
cards.footer: Usually −1 Effect the next time it applies, then discard. The Storyteller may define another fitting effect or removal condition.
cards.description:
A Complication makes your life harder.
Usually −1 Effect the next time it applies, then discard. The Storyteller may define another fitting effect or removal condition.

cards.title: Freezing
cards.body: Every turn you end with 2x Freezing or more, you receive a Distress. Cancelled by Burning.

cards.description:
Every turn you end with 2x Freezing or more, you receive a Distress. Cancelled by Burning.
Use an action or an Asset to discard.

cards.title: Burning
cards.body: Every turn you end with 2x Burning or more, you receive an Injury. Cancelled by Freezing.
cards.footer: Use an action or an Asset to discard.
cards.description:
Every turn you end with 2x Burning or more, you receive an Injury. Cancelled by Freezing.
Use an action or an Asset to discard.

cards.body: You need +1 Distress to get Panicked or Hopeless.
cards.footer: Recover from Panicked.

You need +1 Distress to get Panicked or Hopeless.
Recover from Panicked.

cards.body: You need +1 Injury to be Taken Out.
cards.footer: Recover from being Taken Out.
cards.description:
You need +1 Injury to be Taken Out.
Recover from being Taken Out.

cards.body: You are always Panicked, but you get Hindered instead of Hopeless.
cards.footer: Defend from a Distress while Panicked.
cards.description:
You are always Panicked, but you get Hindered instead of Hopeless.
Defend from a Distress while Panicked.

cards.body: Playing a Partial Success to attack an opponent while unarmed inflicts +1 Injury.
cards.footer: Knock out an opponent unarmed.
cards.description:
Playing a Partial Success to attack an opponent while unarmed inflicts +1 Injury.
Knock out an opponent unarmed.

cards.title: Flex
cards.body: +1 Effect when using your body to impress or intimidate.
cards.footer: Impress or intimidate someone with your body.
cards.description:
+1 Effect when using your body to impress or intimidate.
Impress or intimidate someone with your body.

cards.title: Oversized Weaponry
cards.body: You can use oversized weapons. You can wield two-handed weapons in one hand.
cards.footer: Hit something with a weapon too large to wield easily.
cards.description:
You can use oversized weapons. You can wield two-handed weapons in one hand.
Hit something with a weapon too large to wield easily.

cards.body: You can throw characters of your size or smaller up to 1 zone away.
cards.footer: Throw something most people cannot throw.
cards.description:
You can throw characters of your size or smaller up to 1 zone away.
Throw something most people cannot throw.

cards.body: Your melee attacks leave enemies open—they receive a Complication.
cards.footer: Strike an enemy so hard they stagger or fall.
cards.description:
Your melee attacks leave enemies open—they receive a Complication.
Strike an enemy so hard they stagger or fall.

cards.body: Play Success to intimidate all enemies in your zone, giving them 1 Distress.
cards.footer: Intimidate multiple opponents at once.
cards.description:
Play Success to intimidate all enemies in your zone, giving them 1 Distress.
Intimidate multiple opponents at once.

cards.body: When you successfully block a melee attack, you automatically grapple the attacker.
cards.footer: Restrain an enemy in close combat.

When you successfully block a melee attack, you automatically grapple the attacker.
Restrain an enemy in close combat.

cards.description:
If you grapple an enemy for 2 consecutive turns, they lose consciousness.
Hold an opponent down until they submit or pass out.

cards.description:
You can split you melee attack Effect between enemies in the same zone.
Knock down 3 or more opponents with a single melee attack.

cards.body: Receive 2x Boosts at the start of a social Encounter with a character that may find you attractive.
cards.footer: Seduce someone.
cards.description:
Receive 2x Boosts at the start of a social Encounter with a character that may find you attractive.
Seduce someone.

cards.body: Once per round, you can move to an adjacent zone when you defend from taking any Injury.

cards.description:
Once per round, you can move to an adjacent zone when you defend from taking any Injury.
Retreat from a zone where you received an Injury.

cards.title: Ghost Step
cards.body: +1 Effect while moving silently.
cards.footer: Sneak past an enemy without being detected.
cards.description:
+1 Effect while moving silently.
Sneak past an enemy without being detected.

cards.title: Master of Disguise
cards.body: +1 Effect when you assume a false identity.
cards.footer: Deceive someone by assuming a false identity.
cards.description:
+1 Effect when you assume a false identity.
Deceive someone by assuming a false identity.

cards.body: You can apply poison to a weapon and attack with it in 1 action. You don't poison yourself by mistake.
cards.footer: Poison someone.
cards.description:
You can apply poison to a weapon and attack with it in 1 action. You don't poison yourself by mistake.
Poison someone.

cards.footer: Deceive someone with a forged evidence.
cards.description:
+1 Effect when manipulating with forged documents. The documents always hold up under casual inspection.
Deceive someone with a forged evidence.

cards.body: Your attacks deal +1 Injury or Distress to unaware enemies.
cards.footer: Knock-out or assassinate an unaware target in 1 action.
cards.description:
Your attacks deal +1 Injury or Distress to unaware enemies.
Knock-out or assassinate an unaware target in 1 action.

cards.body: +1 Effect when braking into or out of locked places or containers.
cards.footer: Break a lock.
cards.description:
+1 Effect when braking into or out of locked places or containers.
Break a lock.

cards.body: When you play a Success or better to pickpocket someone, you get an extra asset.
cards.footer: Steal an item from a person without them noticing.
cards.description:
When you play a Success or better to pickpocket someone, you get an extra asset.
Steal an item from a person without them noticing.

cards.body: +1 Effect when hurting someone indirectly.
cards.footer: Kill or knock-out someone indirectly.
cards.description:
+1 Effect when hurting someone indirectly.
Kill or knock-out someone indirectly.

cards.body: Once per scene, reveal a hidden weapon to attack with +2 Effect.
cards.footer: Smuggle a weapon somewhere.
cards.description:
Once per scene, reveal a hidden weapon to attack with +2 Effect.
Smuggle a weapon somewhere.

cards.description:
Play a Success to allow all allies that can hear you to discard a Complication or receive a Boost.
Boost an ally.

cards.body: You get 2x the food when foraging.
cards.footer: Forage some food.
cards.description:
You get 2x the food when foraging.
Forage some food.

cards.title: Tracker
cards.body: +1 Effect while tracking.
cards.footer: Find someone you are tracking.
cards.description:
+1 Effect while tracking.
Find someone you are tracking.

cards.body: Your camouflage always holds up unless inspected.

cards.description:
Your camouflage always holds up unless inspected.
Camouflaging yourself from an enemy for 3 rounds.

cards.footer: Knock-out or kill an enemy with one shot.
cards.description:
Hitting an enemy without an Injury inflicts +1 Injury.
Knock-out or kill an enemy with one shot.

cards.description:
Play a Special Action to teach your pet a new trick.
Make an animal follow your command.

cards.footer: Make a trap and capture an enemy or an animal in it.
cards.description:
Your traps don't hurt you or your allies.

cards.description:
You can shoot ranged weapons 1 zone further.
Hit a target 3 zones away.

Weapons never break or jam when you use them.

You can apply extra ranged Injury left after defeating an enemy to another enemy in the same zone.

Survive a natural hazard without consequences.

cards.description:
+1 Effect when handling animals.
Calm down an aggressive animal.

cards.description:
Your Outcome card hand limit is increased by 1.
Reach a +4 Effect on your action.

cards.description:
You never hit yourself with your own explosives.

cards.description:

Gain a clue by studying a text document.

You automatically recognize common plants. You receive +1 Effect when using plants for medicine, poison, or alchemy.

Chemicals you craft have +1 Effect or +1 round duration.
Create an effective potion, poison, or explosive compound.

You don't need specialized tools when repairing or crafting.

Design and build a completely new tool or device.

Detect an unseen threat before it strikes.

Play a Success to detect underlying emotions of a character.
Call out a liar.
